h1: Square Pizza in Long Branch: Grandma & Sicilian Pies
dek: Looking for square pizza in Long Branch? Gigi's NY Style Pizza on Brighton Avenue bakes both kinds of square pie: the thin, crisp Grandma and the thicker, airier Sicilian, plus the vodka-sauce Drunken Grandma and the Sicilian Pan Pie. Order a whole square pie for pickup or delivery at gigislongbranch.com, or call (732) 377-2468.

sections.h2: Grandma vs. Sicilian: what's the difference?
paragraphs: Both are square, pan-baked pies, but they eat very differently. A Grandma pie is the thin one: the dough is pressed into an olive-oiled pan and baked crisp, so you get a low, crunchy crust with the sauce and cheese right up top. A Sicilian is the thick one: the dough gets time to rise in the pan, so the crumb comes out taller and airier with a golden, fried-crisp bottom.
If you want a square that eats like a crisp flatbread, order the Grandma. If you want a square with real chew and height, order the Sicilian. Plenty of tables settle it by ordering one of each.

sections.h2: The square pies on Gigi's menu
paragraphs: Gigi's keeps four square pies on the regular menu: the classic Grandma, the classic Sicilian, the Drunken Grandma — creamy vodka sauce on a thin square Grandma crust — and the Sicilian Pan Pie. Exact current prices are in the table below, fed straight from the register.
Toppings work the same way they do on the round pies: pick each topping for the whole pie or either half, and the kitchen ticket prints exactly where every topping goes.
